messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning: The user asks: "如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？" In Chinese: "If a ball is thrown straight up at 5 m/s, what acceleration will it reach?" They likely mean maximum height? Actually they ask "它將達到什麼加速度？" That translates to "What acceleration will it reach?" But acceleration due to gravity is constant -9.8 m/s^2 downward. Maybe they want maximum height? The question might be misphrased. The user says "If a ball is thrown straight up at 5 m/s, what acceleration will it reach?" That doesn't make sense; acceleration is constant. Perhaps they meant maximum height. The tool calculates maximum height given initial velocity and gravity. So we should use the function to compute maximum height. The user gave initial velocity 5 m/s. Use default gravity 9.8. Then call the function.
